        sc.nextLine();

        vals = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) vals[i] = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        List<Char> chars1 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]) swap(i);
            Char c = new Char(chars[i], vals[i], i);
            if (chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]) wrongChars.add(c);
            chars1.add(c);
        }
        chars1.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(c -> c.val));

        int diff = 0;
        if (!isAntiPalindrome(chars)) {
            if (wrongChars.size() == 1) {
                Char wc = wrongChars.get(0);
                for (Char c : chars1) {
                    if (c.chr != wc.chr && chars[n - c.idx - 1] != wc.chr) {
                        diff = wc.val + c.val;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (wrongChars.size() > 1) {
                Map<Character, Integer> freq = new TreeMap<>();
                for (Char c : wrongChars) freq.merge(c.chr, 1, Integer::sum);
                Map.Entry<Character, Integer> max = freq.entrySet().stream().max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue()).get();
                List<Char> append = new ArrayList<>();
                while (max.getValue() * 2 > wrongChars.size() + append.size()) {
                    for (Char c : chars1) {
                        if (c.chr != max.getKey() && chars[n - c.idx - 1] != max.getKey()
                                && !wrongChars.contains(c) && !append.contains(c)) {
                            append.add(c);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                diff = wrongChars.stream().mapToInt(c -> c.val).sum() + append.stream().mapToInt(c -> c.val).sum();
            }
        }
        System.out.println(IntStream.of(vals).sum() - diff);
    }

    private static void swap(int i) {
        char t = chars[i]; chars[i] = chars[n - i - 1]; chars[n - i - 1] = t;
        int v = vals[i]; vals[i] = vals[n - i - 1]; vals[n - i - 1] = v;
    }

    private static void swap(int i, int j) {
        char t = chars[i]; chars[i] = chars[j]; chars[j] = t;
        int v = vals[i]; vals[i] = vals[n - i - 1]; vals[n - i - 1] = v;

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length / 2; i++) if (a[i] == a[a.length - i - 1]) return false;
